hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to total pieces is $\tealE2:5$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ total pieces.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | ${2}$ | $\stackrel{\times 20}\rightarrow$ | ${40}$
Total | $5$ | $\stackrel{\times 20}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\tealE{40}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.
